blocks.content: 6. The return value of Fibonacci(2) is stored in the map.
Now, Fibonacci(2) finally calculates the map value fib[2]:
This value is then returned to Fibonacci(3).

blocks.alt: Store Return Value of Fibonacci(2) in Map

blocks.content: Also, since the value is now in the map, it will be used automatically whenever Fibonacci(2) is called by later instances of the recursive function.
